name: Bamboozled
summary: A hidden-dice bluffing party game where players must beat the claimed roll or call it a bluff.
rules_text: Players get hidden action cards and up to 3 strike cards elim. On your turn roll 2 dice secretly in a cup. You may order the two numbers either way as your score, except 1+2 as 21 is the unbeatable Jackpot, 1+2 as 12 is the lowest. Doubles outrank all non-doubles. Declare any score to the next player clockwise. Next player chooses: a) accept - must then secretly roll and declare a score that ties or beats the claimed score and pass on, must bluff if unable; b) call bluff - reveal the cup. If roller was bluffing, roller takes a strike, else caller takes a strike. On any strike the required score resets to 0 and the striker starts next round. First to 3 strikes is out. Action cards can alter a die, make doubles or Jackpot, reset, reverse, skip or forgive a failed call. Last player standing wins.
